_help: Card perks shown in the Perks tab. Each card has perks in categories: Hotels, Car rental, Lounges, Dining, Shopping, Other. Fill in English and 繁體 (_zh); build.py makes 简体. Check each perk against its source when you edit it.

cards.name: Visa Infinite
cards.scope: Visa network perks in Asia Pacific. Your bank adds its own (lounges, insurance, rewards).
cards.scope_zh: Visa 在亞太區的網絡禮遇。發卡銀行另有自家禮遇（貴賓室、保險、獎賞）。

perks.title: Visa Luxury Hotel Collection
perks.what: 1,000+ luxury hotels: daily breakfast for two, a food and drink credit, room upgrade and late check-out when available.
perks.what_zh: 全球 1,000 多間豪華酒店：每日兩位早餐、餐飲消費額、視乎情況免費升級房間及延遲退房。

perks.title: Agoda: up to 30% off
perks.what: Up to 30% off hotel bookings on Agoda through the Visa Infinite offer page.
perks.what_zh: 經 Visa Infinite 優惠頁預訂 Agoda 酒店，最高可享七折。

perks.title: IHG and Accor: 20% off
perks.what: 20% off IHG and Accor hotel bookings.
perks.what_zh: 預訂 IHG 及 Accor 酒店可享八折。

perks.title: GHA DISCOVERY Titanium
perks.what: Automatic Titanium status at GHA hotels (Kempinski, Anantara, Pan Pacific and more).
perks.what_zh: 自動獲得 GHA 酒店（Kempinski、Anantara、Pan Pacific 等）Titanium 會籍。

perks.title: Global Blue VIP Lounges
perks.what: Free VIP shopping lounges in Paris, Milan, Rome, Florence, Barcelona, Madrid and Marbella, plus Fast Lane at Milan Malpensa and Rome Fiumicino airports.
perks.what_zh: 免費使用巴黎、米蘭、羅馬、佛羅倫斯、巴塞隆拿、馬德里及馬貝拉的 Global Blue VIP 購物貴賓室，以及米蘭馬爾彭薩和羅馬菲烏米奇諾機場快速通道。

perks.title: Airport dining: up to 20% off
perks.what: Up to 20% off at selected food and drink outlets in seven Asia Pacific airports, and 10% off dining at Harrods.
perks.what_zh: 亞太區七個機場的指定餐飲店最高八折，Harrods 餐廳九折。

perks.title: Harrods Gold and Lotte Duty Free
perks.title_zh: Harrods Gold 及樂天免稅店
perks.what: Free Harrods Rewards Gold tier, and 10% off at Lotte Duty Free downtown stores in Korea.
perks.what_zh: 免費 Harrods Rewards Gold 會籍；韓國樂天免稅店市區分店九折。

cards.name: World Elite
cards.scope: Mastercard network perks in Asia Pacific. Your bank adds its own (lounges, insurance, rewards).
cards.scope_zh: Mastercard 在亞太區的網絡禮遇。發卡銀行另有自家禮遇（貴賓室、保險、獎賞）。

perks.title: Mastercard Luxury Hotels & Resorts
perks.what: 3,800+ five-star hotels: daily breakfast for two, a hotel amenity worth up to US$100, upgrade and early check-in when available, check-out until 3pm.
perks.what_zh: 全球 3,800 多間五星級酒店：每日兩位早餐、價值最高 100 美元的酒店禮遇、視乎情況免費升級及提早入住、延遲至下午 3 時退房。

perks.title: HoteLux Elite Plus
perks.what: Free membership for luxury hotel rates that can include daily breakfast and up to US$100 dining or spa credit per stay.
perks.what_zh: 免費會籍，可預訂豪華酒店優惠價，或包每日早餐及每次入住最高 100 美元餐飲或水療消費額。

perks.title: Hotel status upgrades
perks.what: Status matches such as GHA DISCOVERY Titanium, Wyndham Diamond and I Prefer Titanium, each with its own sign-up rules.
perks.what_zh: 可升級多個酒店會籍，例如 GHA DISCOVERY Titanium、Wyndham Diamond 及 I Prefer Titanium，各有登記條件。

perks.title: Avis President's Club
perks.what: Priority service, a guaranteed one-car upgrade at airports and railway stations, double upgrade at weekends if available, and a free additional driver. Varies by location.
perks.what_zh: 優先服務；機場及火車站保證升級一級，週末視乎情況升級兩級；免費加一位司機。視乎地點而定。

perks.title: Travel eSIM, once a year
perks.what: A free FlexiRoam 3GB eSIM, valid 15 days in 150+ countries, once per calendar year.
perks.what_zh: 每年可免費領取一次 FlexiRoam 3GB eSIM，150 多個國家可用，有效 15 日。

cards.name: World
cards.scope: Mastercard World has fewer network perks than World Elite. Your bank adds its own.
cards.scope_zh: Mastercard World 的網絡禮遇比 World Elite 少。發卡銀行另有自家禮遇。

perks.title: Mastercard Luxury Hotels & Resorts
perks.what: Same programme as World Elite: daily breakfast for two, an amenity worth up to US$100, upgrade and early check-in when available, check-out until 3pm.
perks.what_zh: 與 World Elite 相同：每日兩位早餐、價值最高 100 美元的禮遇、視乎情況免費升級及提早入住、延遲至下午 3 時退房。

perks.title: HoteLux membership
perks.what: Free HoteLux membership for member rates at luxury hotels.
perks.what_zh: 免費 HoteLux 會籍，可享豪華酒店會員價。

cards.name: Platinum
cards.scope: The Hong Kong Platinum Card (charge card). Other countries' versions differ.
cards.scope_zh: 香港 Platinum Card（簽賬卡）。其他地區版本的禮遇不同。

perks.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts
perks.what: Daily breakfast, guaranteed 4pm check-out, upgrade when available and an on-property credit at participating hotels.
perks.what_zh: 參與酒店每日早餐、保證下午 4 時退房、視乎情況免費升級及酒店消費額。

perks.title: The Hotel Collection
perks.what: US$100 experience credit and upgrade when available, for stays of two nights or more.
perks.what_zh: 入住兩晚或以上可享 100 美元消費額，並視乎情況免費升級。

perks.title: Hotel elite status
perks.what: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite, Hilton Gold, ALL Accor elite status and Radisson Rewards Premium.
perks.what_zh: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite、Hilton Gold、ALL Accor 精英會籍及 Radisson Rewards Premium。

perks.title: Platinum Vacation Credit
perks.what: Up to HK$4,500 back a year at Mandarin Oriental, The Peninsula and Club Med. Register first; a spending requirement applies.
perks.what_zh: 每年在文華東方、半島酒店及 Club Med 簽賬可獲最高 HK$4,500 回贈。須預先登記，並有簽賬要求。

perks.title: Hertz Gold Plus Rewards Five Star
perks.title_zh: Hertz Gold Plus Rewards Five Star
perks.what: Discounts, upgrades and priority service at Hertz. Enrol first.
perks.what_zh: Hertz 租車折扣、升級及優先服務。須先登記。

perks.title: Global Lounge Collection
perks.what: 1,550+ lounges in 500+ airports, including Centurion Lounges, Plaza Premium and Priority Pass.
perks.what_zh: 全球 500 多個機場、1,550 多間貴賓室，包括 Centurion Lounge、環亞機場貴賓室及 Priority Pass。

perks.title: Global Dining Credit
perks.what: HK$1,000 a year in Hong Kong and HK$1,000 overseas, plus Two-for-One courses and up to 30% off at 100+ restaurants with Amex Gourmet Club.
perks.what_zh: 每年香港 HK$1,000 及海外 HK$1,000 餐飲簽賬額；Amex Gourmet Club 另有「買一送一」菜式及 100 多間餐廳最高七折。

perks.title: city'super and cinema offers
perks.what: 3% off selected items at city'super and LOG-ON, and Buy-1-Get-1-Free Friday tickets at Broadway Circuit cinemas.
perks.what_zh: city'super 及 LOG-ON 指定貨品 97 折；百老匯院線逢星期五買一送一。

perks.title: Travel insurance
perks.what: Worldwide travel cover when the trip is booked with the Platinum Card, plus purchase protection.
perks.what_zh: 以 Platinum Card 預訂行程即享全球旅遊保障，另有購物保障。
